description.value: A hostel and guesthouse housed in a beautifully converted 1912 Methodist church in Port Alberni's Uptown Art District. The venue doubles as a live music hall that hosts over 100 touring musicians per year, giving overnight guests a unique cultural experience. Accommodation ranges from shared dorm-style bunk rooms to a private 1000-square-foot guesthouse suite, all with keypad self-check-in.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Char's Landing is an operating hostel and guesthouse in a converted 1912 church in Port Alberni. The accommodations page explicitly lists shared kitchen & laundry (hostel) and private kitchen & laundry (guesthouse), and 'Free highspeed Wifi' appears on multiple pages. Secured access is via personal keypad codes, and there are 3 lockers (first come/first served), but no mention of bike-specific storage or any cycling amenities. Phone and address on the website footer match OSM. The OSM email (guesthouse@charslanding.com) differs from the website footer email (info@charslanding.com), likely separate departmental addresses.
concerns: OSM email (guesthouse@charslanding.com) differs from website footer email (info@charslanding.com); likely separate departmental addresses, not a true conflict
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating hostel in Port Alberni offering affordable accommodation with laundry and WiFi — useful for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island, though bike-specific amenities should be confirmed directly with the owner.

Laundry.detail: Shared kitchen & laundry for hostel guests; private kitchen & laundry in the guesthouse suite

Luggage storage.detail: Accommodations page states they accommodate luggage drop-offs for early/late check-in; 3 lockers available first come first served
